title: 第2698章 另一股混乱天雾第2697章 最后的希望
slug: 我修天道见谁都能一招秒
content_zh:
“找少主？可是……我们上哪里去找他啊？我连他在哪里都不知道！”罗老八一脸纠结道。
自从大道争锋开始，罗天就消失不见了。
若是他能找到罗天，又岂能闹出这么多乱子？
灵皇叹息一声，道：“我既然找你们，自然就有寻到罗天大人的办法！”
罗四喜两眼一瞪，道：“您知道寻到少主的办法？那您怎么不早说啊？”
灵皇无奈道：“因为我之前也不知道罗天大人的具体方位！只是刚刚大道道果被抽离的时候，借助众多大道道果的共振，再加上先天之灵的感应，才感知到罗天大人的模糊坐标！但想要前往那里，需要用大道之力，再加上我的魂术一起，开辟出一条特殊的空间通道！而现在此间，唯二还能调用些许大道之力的，就只有你们两个了！”
罗老八和罗四喜闻言，对视一眼，然后齐齐点头道：“好，我们去！”
然而就在这时……
轰！
九天之上，忽然传来一声巨大的轰鸣。
紧跟着，一道道符文，忽然出现在半空之中。
感受到这股气息，众人齐齐抬头望去，就见半空之中，元灵不灭城城主已经抽取完所有的大道道果。
他整个人于空中盘膝而坐，双手结印，无数大道道果被红线卷着，绕着他身侧不断盘旋。
道果划过之处，大道之力残留，写下了一道道特殊的符文。
那些特殊符文，似乎为大世界的规则所不容，在出现的一瞬间，便引来了阵阵天罚。
不过就在这时……
呼！
混乱天雾，从他身上释放出来，将那些符文遮掩，让那恐怖的天罚失去了目标，一时间硬是劈不下来。
而在这个过程中，元灵不灭城城主开始不断炼化混乱天雾。
轰隆隆！

一瞬间，他体内的逆天之力，开始攀升，整个人的气息更是不断增强。
“完了！他要突破了！”罗老八脸色惨白道。
而在这时，灵皇咬牙道：“可恶，要来不及了！你们两个，立刻配合我！”、
他说着，强行催动起为数不多的魂力。
嗡！
紧跟着，一道符文，出现在他面前。
“将你们的大道之力，灌入其中！”灵皇咬牙说道。
“好！”罗老八和罗四喜闻言，没有任何迟疑，同时催动自身的大道之力，朝着那符文灌去。
不过……
“咦？怎么回事？这大道之力，也太慢了吧？”罗老八不解的看着前方的符文。
就见自身的道之力在注入符文的时候，就好像是在用笔墨，重新描摹那个符文。
但是，这描摹的速度极慢，数个呼吸过去，也只是填满了那符文的一个笔画而已。
“这符文可以撬动世界壁障，而大道争锋的世界壁障，本身就强到可怕！若不是那家伙扭曲了接引之门，给这个世界开启了一道缝隙，你们这都做不到！”灵皇解释道。
“好！”罗老八咬着牙，继续催动大道之力。
随着时间一点点推移，大道之力开始不断覆盖符文。
在这个过程中，这符文四周的空间，开始不断波动。
仿佛有一条特殊的空间通道，将要出现在两人面前了。
“还有三笔，快一点！”灵皇看着眼前的符文，开口催促道。
“我们已经很快了……”罗四喜脸色早已经苍白，额头之上冷汗滴落，整个人摇摇欲坠。
嗡！

当剩下两笔的时候，那空间波动越发明显起来。
在两人面前，一条空间裂缝，若隐若现了。
“这……就快要成功了！”罗老八顿时惊喜起来。
兴奋之下，他奋起余勇，再次灌入大道之力。
content_en:
"Looking for the young master? But...where are we going to find him? I don't even know where he is!" Luo Laoba said with a confused look on his face.
Luo Tian has disappeared since the start of the Great Road Confrontation.
If he could find Luo Tian, ​​how could he cause so much trouble?
The Spirit Emperor sighed and said: "Since I am looking for you, I will naturally find a way to find Lord Luo Tian!"
Luo Sixi glared and said, "You know how to find the young master? Then why didn't you tell me earlier?"
The Spirit Emperor said helplessly: "Because I didn't know the specific location of Master Luo Tian before! It was only when the Dao Dao Fruit was extracted just now, with the help of the resonance of many Dao Dao Fruits, and the induction of the innate spirit, that I could sense the vague coordinates of Lord Luo Tian! But to go there, you need to use the power of the Dao, plus my soul skills, to open up a special space passage! And now, the only two people here who can use some power of the Dao are the two of you!"
Luo Laoba and Luo Sixi heard this, looked at each other, then nodded in unison: "Okay, let's go!"
But at this moment...
Boom!
Above the nine heavens, a huge roar suddenly came.
Immediately afterwards, runes suddenly appeared in mid-air.
Feeling this aura, everyone looked up and saw in mid-air that the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City had extracted all the Dao Dao Fruits.
He was sitting cross-legged in the air, with his hands forming seals, and countless Dao Fruits were wrapped in red threads, constantly circling around his side.
Wherever the Dao Fruit passed through, the power of the Dao remained, writing special runes one after another.
Those special runes seemed not to be tolerated by the rules of the big world. The moment they appeared, they attracted waves of heavenly punishment.
But just then...
Phew!
The chaotic sky fog was released from his body, covering up the runes, making the terrifying Heavenly Punishment lose its target and unable to chop it down for a while.
During this process, the Lord of Yuanling Immortal City began to continuously refine Chaos Tianwu.
Boom!
In an instant, the heaven-defying power in his body began to rise, and his aura continued to increase.
"It's over! He's going to break through!" Luo Laoba said with a pale face.
At this moment, the Spirit Emperor gritted his teeth and said: "Damn it, it's too late! You two, cooperate with me immediately!",
He said, forcibly activating the few soul powers.
Buzz!
Immediately afterwards, a rune appeared in front of him.
"Pour the power of your great avenue into it!" the Spirit Emperor said through gritted teeth.
"Okay!" Luo Laoba and Luo Sixi heard the words, without any hesitation, and at the same time mobilized their own great power to pour towards the rune.
But...
"Eh? What's going on? Isn't the power of this avenue too slow?" Luo Laoba looked at the runes in front of him in confusion.
You can see that when your own power of Tao is injected into the runes, it is as if you are using pen and ink to re-draw the runes.
However, the tracing speed was extremely slow. After several breaths, it only filled up one stroke of the rune.
"This rune can move the world barrier, and the world barrier of Dao Zhengfeng is terrifyingly strong! If that guy hadn't twisted the Gate of Entrance and opened a gap in the world, none of you would have been able to do this!" The Spirit Emperor explained.
"Okay!" Luo Laoba gritted his teeth and continued to activate the power of the avenue.
As time went by, the power of the avenue began to cover the runes.
During this process, the space around the rune began to fluctuate continuously.
It seemed that a special space passage was about to appear in front of the two of them.
"There are three more strokes, hurry up!" The Spirit Emperor looked at the runes in front of him and urged.
"We are already very fast..." Luo Sixi's face was already pale, cold sweat was dripping from his forehead, and his whole body was shaky.
Buzz!
When there were only two strokes left, the spatial fluctuations became more and more obvious.
In front of the two people, a crack in space appeared.It's looming.
"This... is almost successful!" Luo Laoba was suddenly pleasantly surprised.
Excited, he plucked up his courage and once again poured in the power of the avenue.
